For instance, users may create their own categories, however, they are required to associate them to a list of classifications provided by the FI. member.summary: Gets or sets the field will be used to profile the bill pay provider's category identifier for transmittal. If all user-created transaction categories that relate to this transaction category classification also relate to a particular category identifier in the third-party bill pay system, and payments for payees must transmit a category, then this field is applicable.
